title: Sherpa-UI type
description: A kind of thing, said once (plan 960 U2): a row type, as a Device, or a graph thing, as a Coworker. Its fields say only what the data is. The store's rules (typeSchema), what a page knows of each field and a grid's columns (typeColumns) are made from them, so a page's source.fields says only what its controls do. A graph thing says its graph part too; its entity's id, label, description and tags are its fields beside its own. typeFaults() reads it.

category.description: The group it stands in, where an app lists its types and the Nodes panel its entities: Records, Runbooks. None, for a graph thing: Custom Nodes.

key.description: The field each row is known by. None: id. It is one of its fields, and required.

time.description: The date field each row's time is: a page's Date filter reads it.

fields.description: Each field, by name, in the order a page lists them. A dotted name reads a part of an object: location.floor.

data.description: Its seed rows: a JSON file or a URL, from the app's folder.

graph.description: A graph thing's graph part (plan 942 D2 A, folded in by plan 960 U2): the sockets every entity of it has, the families its graph may place, and whether it runs. Each entity of it is an entity.v2 whose graph is what it does.

families.description: The families (a kind's category) its graph may place; none, any. A use of an entity is always allowed.

runs.description: It needs the runner to be of use; none, false: only defined.

reusable.description: Its entities are Custom Nodes a graph may place; none, true. False (a Coworker): the Nodes panel leaves them out, and an Output Trigger starts one (plan 949).

query.description: Its entity may keep a query body (a Filter's where) in place of its graph, drawn by its lens; none, false (plan 960 U4.4b).

storedField.description: A field a row holds, or reads from its graph (from): what its data is, never how a control asks for it.

type.description: What its values are. None: text.

values.description: The values it may hold, in the order a page lists them. None: any.

labels.description: A value's name as a reader reads it, where it is not the value.

statuses.description: Each value's look, a Style mode: success, warning, urgent, critical, info.

min.description: A number's least, or a text's fewest characters.

max.description: A number's most, or a text's most characters.

pattern.description: A regular expression each text matches.

time.description: A date that holds a time of day.

from.description: Read from its entity's graph, never kept beside it: a node's id, then a path in its values, as when/every.
